frequencyBand: COCA 高频精选 · v. 第 110 名

coreMemory.english: aux. used to say what is advisable, right, or expected；aux. used to express probability or a reasonable expectation；aux. used with have to talk about a past duty, expectation, or criticism
coreMemory.structure: should do something /ˈʃʊd ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（应该做某事）；should be able to do something /ˈʃʊd ˈbiː ˈeɪbəl ˈtuː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（应该能够做某事）；should have done something /ˈʃʊd ˈhæv ˈdʌn ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（本应该做某事）；should not be confused with /ˈʃʊd ˈnɑt ˈbiː kəˈnfjuːzd ˈwɪð/（不应与……混淆）

structures.phrase: should be able to do something

coreMemory.commonError: ❌ should be able doing something → ✅ should be able to do something；❌ should not be confused → ✅ should not be confused with

commonErrors.right: should be able to do something
commonErrors.note: 这个结构要用 should + to + 动词原形；do 只是词卡里的动词占位符，真实句子要换成 finish、check 等具体动词。
在“should not be confused with”这个常用搭配中，介词 with 负责连接后面的对象或范围，不能省略或随意换成其他介词。

coreMemory.derivatives: 本词暂无需额外强记的高频派生词

synonyms.difference: ought to 侧重“应该；应当”。对应的常用英文义是 “used to express advice, duty, expectation, or probability”。should 在本卡搭配“should do something”中表达“应该”；换词时要同时检查宾语和介词。

antonyms.usage: 在“应该”这个义项下，should not（不应该）与 should 形成对比。对应的常用英文义是 “opposite of should”。只在这个明确义项和句型中对比，不把两个词的所有用法都视为相反。
